ModMetaData.name: Twitch Chat RimWorld
ModMetaData.author: Kurainu
ModMetaData.description: Bring your Twitch chat into RimWorld. Animals, raiders and visitors are named after your chatters, and their messages appear as in-game speech bubbles with Twitch, Unicode 17.0, BTTV, FFZ and 7TV Emote Support.\n\nNo Twitch account Authorization needed.Just set your channel in the mod settings (Mod Options -> Twitch Chat) and you're done.
